_comment: publish-release.ps1 -Campaigns <this file>: one campaign pack per DCS server.
Key = the server's bfdb instance id (fowlengine.yaml bfdb.instances[].id, e.g. vs1),
or, on a box without bfdb.instances, its DCSServerBot instance name (DCS.vectorstrike_1).
cfg      = the campaign config on THIS PC (validated as JSON before packing).
cfg_name = its name on the server, <sortie>_CFG (default: the cfg file's own name).
miz      = mission file(s); each replaces the file of the same name on that server.
Relative paths are relative to this file. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
